entry.shape: native mixed plugin: definePluginEntry default export; four api.registerTool version-2 factories ({ contextVersion: 2, create }) registered optional; one api.registerCli root command
entry.manifest: openclaw.plugin.json: id sess, contracts.tools, toolMetadata optional, cliCommands sess, skills ./skills, strict configSchema
hostRuntimeUsed: api.runtime.state.openKeyedStore({ namespace, maxEntries, overflowPolicy: 'reject-new' }).withCurrent({ assertCurrent }) -> observe / compareAndApply / registerIfAbsent / lookup
tool context v2: assertInvocationCurrent, agentId, sessionKey, sessionId; assertMemoryAudienceCurrent when supplied

1_entryAndGuard.evidence: Installed packed plugin loads (plugins inspect --runtime: status loaded, 4 tools, cli sess, diagnostics []); version-2 factory receives assertInvocationCurrent (function) on /tools/invoke calls.

2_identityBinding.binding: exact (agentId, sessionKey, sessionId) from the v2 tool context; sessionKey is compared, never parsed
demonstrated: a different conversation (session key) is refused the same handle (real host)
a different agent or sessionId is refused (unit, fake host)
a call without a host sessionId (unstarted main session) is refused HOST_BINDING_UNAVAILABLE
plugin reload (plugins reload sess) keeps records and re-admits the same binding
host aborts the tool signal when the caller disconnects; polling stops
2_identityBinding.gap: Reset rejection NOT demonstrated: on 2026.10.3 both sessions.reset and a /reset chat command kept sessionId for a transcript-less dashboard session (only lifecycleRevision, which tool contexts do not expose, changed). /tools/invoke supplies no memoryAudience/assertMemoryAudienceCurrent. Host docs state sessionId is regenerated on /new and /reset for chat sessions; that path needs an agent-turn qualification (requires a model turn, not authorized here). Revocation-mid-wait rejection is unit-tested only.

3_durableState.evidence: Pending record written before a gateway stop was read after restart; the same handle resumed and returned a verified answer. Store is bounded with overflowPolicy reject-new (host-documented non-evicting for new keys); a capacity-pressure run is deferred to G2.

4_privateLinkBeforeWait.evidence: sess_request returns humanUrl in its private tool result before any wait; sess_response performs the wait. Early delivery through a chat surface (delivery.send / Control UI) was NOT qualified (needs an LLM-driven channel turn), so no automatic in-turn link display is claimed.

5_asyncResultTimeoutCancel.evidence: Verified answer returned through the same live sess_response call ~1.3 s after human submission; caller disconnect aborted the tool signal and stopped polling; a 120 s tool call was not cut by the host on /tools/invoke (adapter budget ended it as needs_resume). Agent-turn host tool timeout NOT measured.

6_setupDoctor.evidence: openclaw --help lists sess from manifest metadata; openclaw sess doctor reads config presence only, prints no secrets, contacts no network. setup is deferred: config-writing consent semantics were not qualified; owners use openclaw config set plugins.entries.sess.config.* and the Gateway environment.

7_installer.evidence: openclaw plugins install npm-pack:<tgz> installs into a per-plugin npm project with --omit=dev --omit=peer --ignore-scripts, installs @sess.si/sdk automatically, and links the peer openclaw to the running host (no second gateway). Requires --force (non-ClawHub source) and --accept-capabilities (capability consent).
